rationales: Fungi are eukaryotic organisms, not bacteria.
Monera includes bacteria in the traditional five-kingdom classification.
Protista includes mostly unicellular eukaryotes, not bacteria.
Animalia consists of multicellular animals, not bacteria.
Carbohydrates are not the principal molecular class of enzymes.
Most enzymes are proteins.
Lipids are not the principal molecular class of enzymes.
Most enzymes are not nucleic acids, although a few catalytic RNAs exist.
Chloroplasts contain their own DNA, so this option is correct.
Ribosomes do not contain their own DNA.
Mitochondria contain their own DNA, so this option is also correct.
Golgi bodies do not contain their own DNA.
Lipids are not the main structural material of prokaryotic cell walls.
Chitin is found in fungal cell walls, not typical prokaryotic cell walls.
Peptidoglycan is the characteristic cell-wall material of most bacteria.
Cellulose is characteristic of plant cell walls.
The endoplasmic reticulum is not the source of the vesicles that form the phragmoplast.
Golgi-derived vesicles gather to form the cell plate within the phragmoplast.
The nucleus does not supply these vesicles.
Mitochondria do not supply these vesicles.
Crossing over occurs during prophase I of meiosis.
Crossing over does not occur during metaphase I.
Crossing over does not occur during anaphase I.
Crossing over does not occur during telophase I.
Chlorophyll reflects much of the green light rather than absorbing it strongly.
Chlorophyll absorbs light most strongly in the blue and red regions.
Orange is not one of chlorophyll’s two main absorption regions.
Green is not one of chlorophyll’s two main absorption regions.
70% is below the commonly cited unsaturated-fatty-acid proportion for sunflower oil.
75% is below the commonly cited unsaturated-fatty-acid proportion for sunflower oil.
80% is below the commonly cited unsaturated-fatty-acid proportion for sunflower oil.
About 85% of the fatty acids in sunflower oil are unsaturated.
Plaques are deposits that can contribute to arterial narrowing, not the name of the condition.
Atherosclerosis involves plaque buildup that narrows arteries.
Arteriosclerosis refers broadly to thickening and hardening of arterial walls.
An embolus is a traveling blockage, not the general term for arterial narrowing.
Monerans are prokaryotes and do not undergo meiosis.
Some fungi undergo meiosis during sexual reproduction.
Plants undergo meiosis to produce spores or gametes in their life cycles.
Animals undergo meiosis to produce gametes.
One gram of lipid yields more than 4 kilocalories.
One gram of lipid yields about 9 kilocalories.
10 kilocalories is not the standard energy yield per gram of lipid.
12 kilocalories is not the standard energy yield per gram of lipid.
Mushrooms are not plants.
Mushrooms are not protists.
Mushrooms belong to kingdom Fungi.
Mushrooms are eukaryotes, not monerans.
Proteases do not digest acids as their substrate.
Carbohydrates are digested by enzymes such as amylases, not proteases.
Proteases catalyse the breakdown of proteins.
Lipids are digested by lipases, not proteases.
In anaphase, chromosomes move toward the poles rather than having arrived there.
In metaphase, chromosomes are aligned at the cell’s equator.
In telophase, the chromosomes have arrived at the poles.
Prophase precedes chromosome separation and movement to the poles.
Veins carry blood toward the heart.
Arteries carry blood away from the heart.
Capillaries connect arterioles and venules and are not defined by carrying blood toward the heart.
Xylem transports water in plants, not blood in animals.
